name: com.manhourplan/pagemd
title: PageMD
description: PageMD: web page to Markdown, links and domain intel (x402), plus free agent_readiness_scan.

tools.name: agent_readiness_scan
tools.description: Free check of how readable and usable a public website is for AI agents: llms.txt, robots.txt AI-crawler rules, sitemap, schema.org JSON-LD, MCP and x402 discovery, OpenAPI, and whether the page is readable without JavaScript. Returns a 0-100 score, a grade, and a fix list. Rate-limited to 10 scans per IP per UTC day. No payment and no API key.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the site or page to scan

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Read a public web page as clean Markdown for LLMs: title, description, canonical URL, main content as Markdown, word count and prompt-injection flags. Respects robots.txt; not charged if the page cannot be read. — $0.001 USDC per call via x402 v2 (Base or Solana).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to read

max_chars.description: Optional cap on returned Markdown length (500-100000, default 20000)

tools.name: page_links
tools.description: Page metadata and links: title, description, canonical, OpenGraph image, language, RSS/Atom feeds, plus every internal and external link with its anchor text. Respects robots.txt; not charged on failure. — $0.001 USDC per call via x402 v2 (Base or Solana).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page

tools.name: domain_intel
tools.description: Domain intel in one call: DNS A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME and CAA records, SPF and DMARC policy, plus RDAP registrar, creation and expiry dates, age in days and status codes. — $0.002 USDC per call via x402 v2 (Base or Solana).

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com (a URL is also accepted; its host is used)

tools.name: security_headers
tools.description: Security headers check for a public URL: fetches it and reports HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP/COEP and cookie flags, with a 0-100 score, grade and concrete fixes. Not charged if the site cannot be reached. — $0.001 USDC per call via x402 v2 (Base or Solana).

tools.name: prompt_injection_check
tools.description: Prompt-injection risk check for agents: GET ?url= scans a public page (visible and hidden text, comments, attributes, meta, JSON-LD) or POST JSON {"text"} (max 50 KB) scans raw text. Flags instruction overrides, role/system-prompt spoofing, secret exfiltration asks, tool-call coercion, hidden or unicode-smuggled text, base64 instructions and markdown image exfil links. Returns a 0-100 risk score, low/medium/high verdict and findings. Heuristic; not charged on failure. — $0.002 USDC per call via x402 v2 (Base or Solana).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to scan (use this or text)

text.description: Raw text/Markdown/HTML to scan instead of a URL (max 50 KB; best sent as POST JSON body)
